races.name: Royal Ascot Trials At Naas Rated Race

runners_data.name: Shaftesbury Avenue
runners_data.note: Front-running type with Ryan Moore's tactical brilliance, 48 days off but Ballydoyle horses often improve for their return

runners_data.name: Victory Tip
runners_data.note: Prominent runner switching to Henry De Bromhead, good recent Gowran form but trainer struggling with 5/45 strike rate

runners_data.name: Accredited
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 5lb claimer Jack Cleary, highest official rating but 56 days since impressive Leopardstown maiden win

runners_data.name: Latin America
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won well at the Curragh last time, proven on good ground and improving for Murtagh

runners_data.name: New Radical
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from small yard, won well last time at Gowran but trainer yet to score in 2024

runners_data.name: Port Ferdinand
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who ran well at Leopardstown recently, another Ballydoyle runner with strong recent form

runners_data.name: Bobby McGee
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with back-to-back wins, proven on good ground and handles the distance well

races.paceDynamic: Shaftesbury Avenue, Victory Tip, New Radical and Bobby McGee will contest the early lead in this seven-runner field, with Shaftesbury Avenue likely to establish control given Ryan Moore's tactical nous and the horse's proven front-running ability. The pace will be genuine but manageable over this stiff mile, as none of the prominent runners are pure speed merchants who would create excessive pressure. Accredited, Latin America and Port Ferdinand will track from mid-division and hold-up positions respectively, setting up a tactical finish. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can secure good positions early and have the class to sustain their effort up Naas's demanding climb.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Shaftesbury Avenue Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Shaftesbury Avenue gets an uncontested lead and Ryan Moore can dictate fractions
scenarios.body: Moore will slow the pace mid-race before quickening approaching the home turn, making it difficult for hold-up horses to close on the testing climb. The combination of class, tactical position and pilot experience proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Victory Tip, New Radical or Bobby McGee press Shaftesbury Avenue early
scenarios.body: The increased pace will set up the race for the hold-up horses who can use their superior class ratings to close strongly up the hill. Latin America's recent Curragh win over this trip marks him as the main beneficiary.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swamp
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling with multiple prominent horses refusing to commit early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where pure class tells, favouring the highest-rated Accredited despite his inexperienced claimer. Port Ferdinand's recent Leopardstown third suggests he's ready to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: New Radical Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Jack Davison's charge can secure an ideal tracking position behind the leaders
scenarios.body: His recent Gowran Park win over course specialists suggests untapped improvement, and the 0/7 trainer record becomes irrelevant with the right tactical ride. The lighter weight aids his cause up the testing climb.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Victory Tip or Bobby McGee press Shaftesbury Avenue early as this could set up a completely different tactical race
Watch Latin America's position turning for home as he needs clear daylight to show his best finishing kick
Watch how quickly Jack Cleary commits Accredited in the straight given his inexperience in tactical finishes
Watch the pace through the first half-mile as a slow tempo would completely change the complexion
Watch Port Ferdinand for market confidence as Ballydoyle's third string could be overpriced if showing well in preliminaries

races.paceDynamic: Fast Tara will lead uncontested with Glory To Be, Vega's Muse, Jagged Edge and Red Charlie taking prominent positions behind. With only one confirmed front-runner, Fast Tara can dictate a steady gallop without pressure, setting up a tactical affair. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Far From Dandy, Booyea, Final Voyage, Dark Viper, Bella Isabella, Speckled Meadow, Daler and Senna's Girl will be bunched at the rear waiting for the sprint. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours closers who can time their runs from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Fast Tara sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays steady throughout
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses get their ideal setup with plenty to aim at in the straight. Class and finishing speed become the decisive factors with the strongest closers prevailing.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Glory To Be or Vega's Muse press Fast Tara from the start creating early tempo
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches the field earlier and sets up the race for mid-division runners who can stay closer to the pace. Those with tactical speed from prominent positions benefit most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sprint Develops Late
scenarios.trigger: If Fast Tara kicks clear turning for home before the closers can organize
scenarios.body: The leader steals crucial lengths while the hold-up brigade are still getting organized behind. Fast Tara's stamina and recent form make this a genuine possibility despite the pace setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys get caught napping behind the steady pace and leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble in the final furlong with positioning crucial. Those drawn best and getting first run from the pack can capitalize on the tactical muddle.

watchPoints.text: Fast Tara could steal this if allowed uncontested lead and finds stamina reserves late

runners_data.name: What A Girl Wants
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with solid recent form on similar going, well-suited to track the expected steady pace.

runners_data.name: Cyclone Code

runners_data.name: New Yorker

races.paceDynamic: Your Song will set the pace alone from the front, with What A Girl Wants, New Yorker and Cyclone Code tracking prominently behind. The relatively small field and lack of natural pace pressure means Your Song can dictate comfortable fractions without being harried early. Star Prospect will need to overcome his hold-up style from the rear in what shapes as a steadily-run affair. This race profile strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and pounce, as the lack of early pressure will leave plenty in reserve for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Comfortable Pace Favours Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Your Song sets uncontested fractions and the prominent runners get first run
scenarios.body: What A Girl Wants and New Yorker can utilize their superior ratings to strike from ideal tracking positions. The lack of early pace will suit these prominent types who won't be taken out of their comfort zones.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Your Song's sustainable pace proves too much and no tracker can reel her in
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure allows Your Song to maintain a strong gallop to the line despite her moderate rating. Her familiarity with leading gives her a tactical edge over higher-rated but less experienced rivals.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Produces Late Kick
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and allows time for a sustained finish from the rear
scenarios.body: Star Prospect's proven ability and higher rating tells as Ryan Moore times a perfectly judged challenge from off the pace. The straight 5f at Naas provides ample opportunity for his finishing kick to be effective.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightly-Raced Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If Pala Aurelia shows significant improvement from her debut and benefits from the tactical scenario
scenarios.body: Stack's filly utilizes her unknown potential and gets a perfect tow into the race from her prominent position. Seamie Heffernan's experience proves crucial in a tactical finish where ratings matter less.

watchPoints.text: Your Song's fitness after 43-day layoff - any signs of rustiness early could compromise her pace-setting role
Star Prospect's position turning for home - needs to be within striking distance or his hold-up style becomes ineffective
What A Girl Wants' position behind the leaders - must avoid being shuffled back from her ideal tracking spot
Pala Aurelia's early positioning - will reveal Stack's intended tactics and her likely improvement since debut

races.paceDynamic: Greek Mythology and Wannabe Royal will set a contested early pace, with neither naturally conceding the lead. Expanded and Chantez will track closely in second/third, ensuring the tempo stays honest throughout the 7f trip. The strong pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to deliver late, with multiple closers (Rahmi, Native Warrior, King Cuan, East Hampton) getting ideal conditions to unleash finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and late runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Benefit Strong Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Greek Mythology and Wannabe Royal clash early and maintain honest fractions
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will find out the pace-setters in the final furlong, allowing the quality hold-up horses to sweep past with superior finishing kicks. Rahmi and Native Warrior have the class and tactical positioning to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too fierce between the two confirmed leaders
scenarios.body: Both Greek Mythology and Wannabe Royal will hit the wall inside the final two furlongs, creating a cavalry charge finish. The prominent racers who avoided the early battle will have the perfect setup to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Greek Mythology Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Greek Mythology can establish a length lead over Wannabe Royal early
scenarios.body: The class colt can dictate more reasonable fractions and potentially stay on strongly, though still vulnerable to one closer. His recent form suggests he has the tactical speed to avoid a grinding battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders show more restraint than expected and settle
scenarios.body: A steadier tempo would neutralize the hold-up horses' advantage and bring stamina more into play. The race becomes more open to all running styles with positioning crucial.

watchPoints.text: Greek Mythology and Wannabe Royal if they engage in prolonged early speed duel - both could collapse dramatically
Chantez returning from 259-day layoff with trainer struggling for winners this month

races.paceDynamic: Velozee and Vollering are both confirmed front-runners who will clash early and set the tempo from the gates. With only 6 runners over 6f on good turf, this creates an honest but not breakneck gallop where the pace will be testing but sustainable. The small field means less interference but also less cover for hold-up horses, with prominent runners like Victorious and Maria Quiteria able to track the leaders without getting trapped. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can sit handy and capitalize when the two pace-setters potentially weaken each other.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Velozee and Vollering engage early and compromise each other's finishing kick...
scenarios.body: The honest pace suits horses sitting just behind who can time their challenge perfectly. Victorious with Ryan Moore aboard is ideally placed to exploit this scenario with her proven class edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favours Class
scenarios.trigger: If one front-runner (likely Velozee) gets an uncontested lead while the other settles...
scenarios.body: The superior horse gets easy fractions and kicks clear, with the tactical battle happening for minor honors behind. Velozee's recent 106 RPR and winning form makes her the primary beneficiary.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Small Field Sprint Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the small field creates a messy tactical affair with false pace early...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the 3f pole where raw speed matters most, potentially suiting an unknown quantity. Controlla's lightly-raced profile could be dangerous if she has untapped ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Steady Tempo Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters show restraint and create moderate early fractions...
scenarios.body: The race sets up perfectly for any horse with a closing kick, though the small field limits this possibility. Dancing Destiny from the back could emerge late if the pace collapses completely.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Velozee and Vollering go too fast early as this will set up the race for Victorious to strike late
Watch Maria Quiteria's fitness after 51 days off, as ring-rustiness could cost her crucial early speed
Watch Controlla's market moves for clues about her ability given her unproven status in this grade
Watch if Dancing Destiny can adapt from her 8f run to this sprint distance with only 6 days recovery

races.paceDynamic: Charles Darwin, Royal Bay Cen, and Kindergarten will engage in immediate combat from the stalls, with all three possessing genuine front-running instincts that guarantee a fierce early gallop. This triumvirate will stretch the field out quickly, creating a searching test of stamina over the straight 6f at Naas. The relentless early fractions will leave prominent runners like Havana Anna and Josh's Joy needing to travel strongly to maintain contact, while the strong pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to finish with one devastating run. This race shape strongly favours hold-up specialists who can unleash their kick off the guaranteed strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners Charles Darwin, Royal Bay Cen, and Kindergarten duel too fiercely early
scenarios.body: The blistering pace will leave all three leaders vulnerable in the final furlong, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past with fresh finishing kicks. Tahcawin and Chicago Call, both natural closers, will benefit most from this self-destructive speed battle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Havana Anna or Josh's Joy can secure ideal stalking positions behind the speed duel
scenarios.body: The class horses tracking in behind can time their challenge perfectly, avoiding the early speed battle while positioning close enough to strike decisively. Havana Anna's superior rating of 113 makes her the prime beneficiary if she can get the trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Charles Darwin uses his class and Ryan Moore's tactical nous to dictate more sensible fractions
scenarios.body: The Ballydoyle star could steal a march by easing the tempo just enough to preserve his kick, leaving Royal Bay Cen and Kindergarten to battle each other into submission. His superior OR of 110 and proven form at this level gives him the edge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders check each other's speed and settle into a tactical crawl
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where natural speed rather than stamina dominates, completely changing the tactical picture. This unlikely scenario would favour horses with raw pace rather than those depending on a strong gallop.

races.paceDynamic: Valiant Force takes them along as the only confirmed front runner, setting sustainable fractions without early pressure. The real congestion sits behind him with Mission Central, Moss Tucker, Ipanema Queen, Lady Iman, and Likedbymike all wanting prominent positions - creating a traffic-heavy bunch 2-3 furlongs out. The hold-up brigade of Keke, Kerdos, Black Forza, Gazelle d'Or, Sarahmae, and Billie Be Quick will be looking for gaps in the final furlong as the prominent runners tie up. This race shape strongly favours the patient hold-up horses who can navigate the inevitable traffic and finish fastest when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates the expected traffic jam turning for home
scenarios.body: The backmarkers get clear runs while the early prominent runners compromise each other in a bunched finish. Keke and Black Forza benefit most from their patient tactics and superior closing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Valiant Force gets easy fractions and the prominent pack doesn't organise a strong challenge
scenarios.body: The leader holds on as the chasers get in each other's way, with only the best hold-up horse getting there in time. Mission Central's class might just get him close enough to threaten.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If Mission Central and Lady Iman break clear from the prominent bunch before the traffic develops
scenarios.body: The superior quality horses assert themselves early enough to avoid the messy finish, with Ryan Moore's tactical nous getting Mission Central into the perfect position. The hold-up horses leave it too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If Valiant Force goes too slow and everyone gets there together in a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: The entire field arrives in a bunch with little between them, favouring the horse with the best turn of foot regardless of early position. Chaos finish with any of the better horses capable of nicking it.
